synthesizedFacts.fact: Collagen supplements are generally considered safe when taken in doses up to 10 grams daily for up to 6 months.
Mild digestive issues such as bloating and gas are common side effects of collagen supplements.
Allergic reactions to collagen supplements are rare but possible, especially if derived from bovine or marine sources.
There is a reported case of Stevens-Johnson Syndrome/Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis overlap induced by collagen supplements.
Collagen supplements may improve skin hydration and elasticity, particularly in older adults.
